title: Clarify the purpose and non-endorsement status of the D.1 tool list
requirements:
- State that the list is illustrative, non-exhaustive and not an endorsement or evidence of conformance
- Keep a few dated examples in the publication and maintain the full catalogue online
- Publish inclusion criteria and an update process
- Note that tool-to-component mappings are many-to-many
- State that security, privacy and residency properties depend on deployment and need separate assessment
